title: Qafila shaam ke darbar ko jo jaane laga
body:
QAFELA SHAM KE DARBAR KO JO JANE LAGA
HAAL YE ABID-E-BIMMAR KO TARDPANE LAGA
Bibiyan jati hai darbar mein qaidi bankar
Qalb-e-Zainab pe museebat ka samaa’n chane laga
<<DIVIDER>>
Dekhti reh gaye Sajjad ko pyasi bachi
Pani dikhla ke adu bachi ko tarsane laga
Gaiz mein aagaya darbar mein kya guzri thi
Sar-e-Shabbir jo Mukhtar ko dikhlane laga
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaanpta reh gaya darbar mein Sheh ka kunba
Sar-e-Mazloom pe zalim jo sitam dhane laga
Nok-e-naiza se tapakne lage aansu Sheh ke
Sar ba rehna jo nabi zadi ko lejane laga
<<DIVIDER>>
Meri godi mein chale aayiye ay baba jaan
Sar-e-Darbar sitamgar mujhe tardpane laga
Hogaya sham ke darbar mein sakta taaree
Sar-e-Shabbir jo beti ki taraf aane laga
<<DIVIDER>>
Aagaye qaid mein Shabbir tadap kar Abbas
Haye bimaar Sakina ko jo dafnane laga
